Non-compliance may result in denial of entry of the vehicle and any consequential delay shall be to the seller's account. 18. rectly or indirectly; ii) The bidder (or his allied firm) provided services for the need assessment/ pr ocurement planning of the Tender process in which it is participating; iii) Procurement of goods directly from the manufacturers/ suppliers shall be pr eferred.
